title: Resolution urging Albany to require slavery-era art provenance signs
summary: This resolution calls on the State Senate to pass and the Governor to sign legislation (A.8192C/S.10107) requiring museums to post signage about the provenance of art and artifacts linked to the transatlantic and domestic slave trade. The requirement would cover items created or acquired between roughly 1500 and 1875, including pieces tied to the exchange for enslaved people or obtained through theft or forced sale. The goal is to give museum visitors more complete and accurate information about such objects' origins.
